ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Processes Spawned by WinRM
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious processes including shells spawnd from WinRM host process

sequences.query: (parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\wsmprovhost\\\.exe$") AND (process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\sh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\bash\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wsl\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\schtasks\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\certutil\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\whoami\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\bitsadmin\\\.exe$")))
